resources.string: Keep Ekagra running in the background
Allow SAFAR to run without battery restrictions so Android is less likely to interrupt your study session. This is the same app-wide setting used by Kavach.

Choose Allow in the Android request. If a battery settings page opens, choose Unrestricted or No restrictions and allow background activity. Return to SAFAR afterwards. Your timer keeps running while you change this setting.
Could not open battery settings. Open Android Settings → Apps → SAFAR → Battery and choose Unrestricted or No restrictions.
